description: 全周期管理平台机构端的数据查询MCP连接器，覆盖医疗数据、管理任务、对话沟通等业务域的查询能力，所有数据仅在对话内分析、不落盘不导出。

display.description_en: Read-only MCP connector for the provider side of the Tencent Health Full-Cycle Care Platform, providing queries across medical records, care management tasks, and patient messaging. Data is analyzed in-conversation only — never stored or exported.

examples_en: How many patients are currently under management?

What do Zhang San's diet and exercise stats look like this month?
